relationships.subject: tonic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Right PBN-PAG FC during pain-free rest positively correlated with subsequently experienced pain (R = 0.44; t = 3.43; p = 0.001). During pain, this connection's FC was diminished (paired t=-3.17; p = 0.0026).

relationships.subject: subgenual anterior cingulate cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: After pain induction sACC-PAG FC became positively correlated with pain intensity (R = 0.38; t = 2.81; p = 0.007).

key_findings: In 50 pain-free participants, sACC-PAG functional connectivity correlated with pain intensity during capsaicin-heat tonic pain, and resting right PBN-PAG FC predicted subsequent pain and was diminished during pain.
